title: A Very Die Hard Christmas
seo_title: A Very Die Hard Christmas Stage Parody in Joplin, MO
description: A Very Die Hard Christmas is a stage parody of the 1988 action film from Dream Theatre Co., told in rhyme by a storybook Narrator with an onstage effects artist making it snow. The show is staged in the round and replays the film's climb with water pistols and Nerf blasters; it runs about 1 hour 45 minutes including intermission and carries a content advisory for foul language and drug use. Performances run December 3 to 5, 2026, at 7:30 PM (doors at 7:00 PM), at 124 S. Main in Joplin, MO.
